name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.dualMassE_stacked_le
title: Block bound: smoothness of [I_l (x) B | W] from that of B and W
statement: For any q > 0, B in Z_q^{n x m}, W in Z_q^{ln x m} and tau: dualMassE([I_l (x) B | W], tau) + 1 <= (S_B + 1)^l (S_W + 1), where S_M is the sum of exp(-pi tau^2 |v|^2/q^2) over nonzero integer vectors v orthogonal (mod q) to the integer kernel of M. Reason: Lambda^perp([I (x) B | W]) contains Lambda^perp(B)^l (+) Lambda^perp(W).
